rewrites.comment: The School-bus-API on Cloud Run. These MUST come before the `**` SPA catch-all: Hosting evaluates rewrites in order and the first match wins. Rewriting rather than calling the run.app URL directly makes the API same-origin, so there is no CORS preflight to configure or misconfigure.
SPA fallback — React Router owns every path, so any URL that is not a real file must serve index.html.

headers.comment: Security headers carried over from the former next.config.ts.
index.html must not be cached, or a deploy leaves clients on the old bundle.
Vite fingerprints every asset filename, so these are safe to cache forever.

The icon subset is a GENERATED artifact with a STABLE filename: scripts/build-icon-font.mjs rewrites the same two paths whenever an icon is added. Unlike /assets/** it is not content-hashed, so it must revalidate — otherwise a client keeps an old subset (missing the new glyph, which then renders as its literal name) for the whole max-age window. Adding a glyph is exactly when this bites. Revalidation costs a 304 on ~100 KiB of fonts.
The service worker must revalidate on every load, or a deploy never reaches clients that already have a worker. It manages its own precache revisions; only the registration entry points need this.
Emitted by vite-plugin-pwa beside sw.js. Same reasoning — it is the registration entry point and must not go stale.
The manifest is re-read on every install/update, so let it revalidate too.
